items.html: And I shall now explain to you my ruling opinion in these disputed discourses, mentioned at the beginning of this chapter. And what appears to me is this: after the two years of Yenika, two aspects enter together, which are the VAK of the Mochin of Gadlut, which then begin to enter his head in the course of six years, as said; and correspondingly, the VAK of the Mochin of the Katnut of Yenika also spread in his body, downward. And it is found that this one enters and that one goes out: this one enters into the Mochin, and that one goes out and spreads in the body. And it is in the manner explained in the intention of the Shema, in chapter 1.
